profile_text.body:
Box is a publicly traded company, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, that provides what it describes as an Intelligent Content Management platform. The platform is built around storing, sharing, and collaborating on unstructured data such as sales presentations, lease agreements, and finance documents, and it combines content management with workflow automation, e-signature capabilities, and security tools including deep learning-based malware detection, automated data classification, and compliance support for frameworks such as GDPR, HIPAA, and FINRA.

The company's primary AI product is Box AI, which the site describes as tapping into models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to deliver real-time summaries, analysis, and recommendations across enterprise content. Box AI Studio allows developers and administrators to customize and deploy AI agents, while a drag-and-drop workflow builder is offered for automating processes such as loan processing and employee onboarding. Box also describes unlimited e-signatures as available at no additional cost within the platform.

According to held facts, Box reported revenue of approximately $1.18 billion for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, filed on a 10-K basis, and trades on a public exchange under the ticker BOX with a CIK of 0001372612. No litigation is recorded in the held facts for this company.
